name: Gacha Forge
description: A configurable gacha game mode. Forge a world from your lorebooks, pull on banners, collect the cast the model writes for you, then take them into battle: play story chapters told by a visual-novel narrator, build a formation, farm materials and level them up. Install it, restart Marinara Engine when prompted, then open Home → Gacha Forge.
author: SonaGate
